2607.27250.title: Do Context Files Help Coding Agents? A Two-Agent Ablation Study on Real Repositories
2607.27250.paper_summary: Persistent context files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) are standard practice for guiding AI coding agents, yet evidence for their effectiveness is contradictory. We present a controlled ablation of context-injection strategy across two frontier agents (Claude Code and Codex), 17 real tasks from 3 repositories (15 shared + 2 Codex-only), and 288 evaluated runs with gold-test evaluation. Context strategy does not measurably move correctness on either agent (bounded to <=10-15pp via equivalence testing). A failure-mode triage reveals why: agents fail on implementation skill---feature design, pattern selection, exact wiring---not missing repository knowledge that a context file could supply; a manipulation probe confirms the real AGENTS.md never converts a near-miss to a pass on either agent. We further show that borderline task difficulty is agent-specific (Spearman rho=0.75), offering a candidate explanation for prior contradictions: single-agent studies draw tasks from different agents' informative bands. We release all code, data, and analysis.
2607.27250.paper_summary_zh: 持久的上下文文件（AGENTS.md，CLAUDE.md）是指導 AI 編碼代理的標準做法，但其有效性的證據卻是矛盾的。<lb/>我們展示了一個控制的上下文注入策略的消融實驗，涵蓋了兩個前沿代理（Claude Code 和 Codex）、來自三個庫的 17 個真實任務（15 個共享 + 2 個僅限 Codex），以及 288 次經過金標測試的評估運行。<lb/>上下文策略在任一代理上並未顯著提高正確性（通過等價測試限制在 <=10-15pp）。<lb/>失敗模式的分類揭示了原因：代理在實施技能上失敗——特徵設計、模式選擇、精確連接——而不是缺少上下文文件可以提供的庫知識；一個操控探針確認真實的 AGENTS.md 從未將接近失敗轉變為任一代理的通過。<lb/>我們進一步顯示邊界任務難度是特定於代理的（Spearman rho=0.75），這為先前的矛盾提供了一個候選解釋：單一代理研究從不同代理的信息帶中抽取任務。<lb/>我們釋放所有代碼、數據和分析。
2607.27250.author: Prakhar Khatri et.al.
